description:
Site themes and templates. Pick the operation with `action` and pass that action's arguments (help:true returns its full documentation and schema).
- list_themes: List all custom themes of the site.
- semantic_search_themes: Semantic search across the theme marketplace using bge-m3 embeddings (cosine similarity).
- list_template_themes: Search/list the public Webcake template marketplace (api.storecake.io).
- create_site_from_template: Create a NEW site from a marketplace TEMPLATE (the dedicated "use this template" API).

help.description: Return the action's full documentation and argument schema instead of running it

limit.description: Number of matches to return (default 5, max 10) [semantic_search_themes, list_template_themes]

query.description: Natural-language description of the desired website (industry + features) [semantic_search_themes]

slug.description: URL-safe slug for the new site (auto-generated if omitted) [create_site_from_template]

switch_to.description: Switch the session to the new site after creating it (saved for next session) [create_site_from_template]

name: theme
